text: Ab English ke paper mein koi bhi fail nahin hoga🎉🥳🥳🥳🥳🥳🥳

That sounds like a funny and relatable moment! 😂 It seems like Dilip's mam asked him to say something in English, and he tried his best to pronounce the words in English, but ended up using Hindi words with an English accent.

The phrase "Maie cilass room meien chawk ki kamhi nohi hoene dounga" is a hilarious example of this. It's like he's saying "My classroom main chalk ki kami nahin hone dunga" (I won't let there be a shortage of chalk in my classroom) in Hindi, but with an English pronunciation.

Moments like these can be entertaining and endearing, especially when kids try their best to communicate in a different language. 🤣 If you've seen this on YouTube, I'd love to know more about the video or the channel it's from!
